pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with crenulated, high-contrast edges. Dark brown patches on the neck are larger and more contiguous, whereas patches on the lower flank exhibit increased fragmentation with smaller spatial area and sharper vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pelage forming a topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is greater on the neck and shoulder regions, narrowing significantly into thin, branched filaments on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck. The mane presents as a short, bristly 1D contour with visible pixel-level serration against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in patch morphology from large, block-like structures on the neck to highly fragmented, stellate patterns on the lower haunch.
